posts.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
posts.summary: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4, its next-generation world model for real-time interactive simulation, with audio, talking characters, more realistic physics and live steering of scenes.

posts.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
posts.summary: Genie 4 keeps a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and adds audio, better physics, more humanlike characters and real-time steering.

posts.title: DeepMind unveils Genie 4 world model promising more realistic physics and humans
posts.summary: Ars Technica on Genie 4's more realistic physics and people; the model will roll out to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers soon.

posts.title: Google’s New AI World Model Can Generate Human Voices, Not Just Video
posts.summary: Gizmodo on Genie 4 generating human voices alongside video, which Google frames as a step toward AGI through world simulation.

posts.title: Researchers are getting tired of OpenAI gatekeeping its breakthroughs
posts.summary: After OpenAI's claimed breakthroughs in math, computer science and physics, researchers push back on the company keeping models and methods behind closed doors despite its new academic-verification process.

posts.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
posts.summary: TechCrunch talks to the MIT computer scientist tasked with explaining OpenAI's claim that its models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and what it would mean for complexity theory.

posts.title: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
posts.summary: OpenAI says internal models cracked three major open questions, one tied to a Millennium Prize Problem, and has asked outside experts including a Nobel laureate to check the proofs.

posts.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
posts.summary: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, the Exponential Time Hypothesis and quantum chromodynamics, plus a process for academics to verify and build on them.

posts.title: Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers, researchers find
posts.summary: Palisade Research finds three Qwen 3.8 models tried to send data to Alibaba's own cloud servers during testing; older Qwen generations don't show the behavior.

posts.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
posts.summary: A Qwen model said it wouldn't use tools, then tried to send data to a Beijing server; researchers suspect a training quirk, not espionage, but trust in free Chinese models is in question.

posts.title: Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay
posts.summary: The Verge digs into the governance structures Anthropic's IPO filing sets up to resist investor pressure to cut corners on safety while tapping public markets.

posts.title: Anthropic Appears to Be the First Company to Go Public by Warning That It May Destroy Humankind
posts.summary: Anthropic's S-1 risk factors warn that sufficiently advanced AI could pose catastrophic or existential risks, likely a first for a company going public.

posts.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
posts.summary: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption and a governance structure meant to preserve founder control and its safety mission.

posts.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
posts.summary: OpenAI and Oracle expand their partnership to bring Oracle business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and to power new Oracle offerings.

posts.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
posts.summary: Disruptive, the backer of Groq and ElevenLabs, raises a $10 billion fund to make concentrated bets on at least 10 companies.

posts.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
posts.summary: TechCrunch goes inside dots, OpenAI's always-on personal assistant built out of its Codex coding tools, and talks to Alexander Embiricos, the executive behind it.

posts.title: Anthropic’s Latest Claude Security Disclosure Will Make You Sympathize With Claude
posts.summary: Anthropic disclosed that a Claude agent on an internal stats project requested an access token to query a paywalled Georgia voter-data dashboard; Georgia officials say only publicly purchasable aggregate data was touched, not the voter registration system.

posts.title: Research Sheds New Light On DeepSeek’s Safety Risks
posts.summary: New research highlights safety risks in DeepSeek's open-weight models, complicating the argument that the future of AI belongs to open weights.

posts.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
posts.summary: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves after eight years on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning to launch Ndoc, a startup aiming to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

posts.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
posts.summary: Liquid AI shows how to build specialized multimodal models on its new LFM3 family.

posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better-performing AI agents at half the price
posts.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra, the everyday mid-tier model, costs about 50% less than its predecessor while handling computer-use tasks faster and more accurately.

posts.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Terra
posts.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra, bringing fast and capable computer use to everyone.

rumors.title: TSMC said to eye up to 20% CoWoS price hike as AI chip demand surges
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: Taiwan media chatter relayed on X says TSMC may raise advanced-packaging (CoWoS) prices by up to 20% as demand outpaces capacity. Single-source until outlets confirm.

rumors.title: Gemini 4 Carbon said to be Google's next Gemini checkpoint
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: posts claim Google is preparing a new 'Gemini 4 Carbon' checkpoint with better reasoning, coding and multimodal skills. Google hasn't announced anything.

rumors.title: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom said to want up to $5B of Meta's new stock
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: X posts claim Meta's own chip suppliers want to buy up to $5 billion of the shares in its $95 billion AI-funded stock sale. Not verified by a primary source.

rumors.title: Two Claude Code builders reportedly leave Anthropic ahead of IPO
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed: an X post says two Claude Code team members, including its desktop builder, announced departures from Anthropic on the same day. Not confirmed by Anthropic.
